title: Joint List · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Joint List · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two players and a broad category such as animals. The pair alternates naming different items in the category until they have named six. All six examples fit the category and none is repeated. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Joint List, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
All six examples fit the category and none is repeated.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: All six examples fit the category and none is repeated.
